name: Shipgrave Maze
introDiscord:
Dozens of wrecks have collected between the skeletons until they form
a maze.

Shipgrave Scuttlers know every route.

Shizuki did not.
introTwitch:
Dozens of wrecks have collected between the skeletons until they form
a maze.

Shipgrave Scuttlers know every route.

Shizuki did not.

left.message: A Shipgrave Scuttler crawls across the ceiling of an overturned ship.

right.message: A strongbox rests inside a captain's cabin.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Ship maze day one.

Not lost.

Conducting comprehensive ship inspection.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and allow the official story to stand.

shipgrave-maze-depths.prompt: The maze becomes several ships deep.

left.message: Star Candies rest beneath an ancient scale protruding through a deck.

right.message: A Scuttler takes a shortcut through a broken hull.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's updated report:

'Ship maze day two.

Inspection extremely comprehensive.

Glimmer has begun laughing.

Morale issue.'

shipgrave-maze-threshold.prompt: Admiral's Ruin sits at the center.

left.message:
Shizuki's bottle:

'DAY THREE.

FOUND CENTER.

Therefore navigation success.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the victory medicine untouched.

right.message: A navigator's chest rests inside the admiral's wreck.

forward.message:
A Scuttler guards the only obvious exit.

Of course.

boss-antechamber.name: Admiral's Ruin
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every Scuttler abandons the central wreck.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every Scuttler abandons the central wreck.

Something much larger crawls across the outside of Admiral's Ruin.

The hull groans beneath its weight.

Use /yes to enter the Ruin or /no to resume Shizuki's comprehensive
inspection somewhere else.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every Scuttler abandons the central wreck.

Something much larger crawls across the outside of Admiral's Ruin.

The hull groans beneath its weight.

Use !yes to enter the Ruin or !no to resume Shizuki's comprehensive
inspection somewhere else.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat deeper into the maze.

This may or may not improve matters.

boss.revealText:
A colossal Scuttler tears across the wreck.

Fleet-Eater Scuttler reveals itself!

completionText:
The Fleet-Eater disappears.

A direct exit lies behind it.

Shizuki's map has seventeen routes.

None are this one.
